summary.text: Juan Carrillo, a Democrat, represents the 39th Assembly District, which covers parts of Los Angeles and San Bernardino counties, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His official website says he was first elected in November 2022, re-elected in November 2024, and previously served on the Palmdale City Council after 15 years as a city planner, 10 of them with the City of Palmdale.

According to the same page, he was born and raised in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, immigrated to Los Angeles at 15, holds degrees from College of the Desert, Cal Poly Pomona and Cal State Northridge, and lives in east Palmdale.
